Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Sell smarter. Buy smarter. Learn your trading style.
Description: One FFXIV Market Board suite containing Should I Sell?, Should I Buy?, and Should I Tycoon?: selling guidance, budget-aware opportunity scanning, vendor and stack arbitrage analysis, confirmed purchase cost-basis capture, personal sales history, and trader performance analytics.
Changelog: v1.1.8 adds exact current-listing state age (price + quantity), expands Should I Tycoon? with an observed gil cashflow ledger and editable income/spend categories, and lets normal Market Board purchases be marked Personal so crafting/glamour buys remain in spending history without polluting FIFO trading positions or P&L.
